description: Rajkummar Rao stars in 'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story,' a film inspired by Ujjwal Nikam's real-life experiences. Nikam emphasized the importance of authenticity, insisting on using actual names without glorifying characters. The movie, directed by Avinash Arun, dives into the prosecution of Ajmal Kasab post the horrific 26/11 Mumbai attacks. With a powerful cast including Wamiqa Gabbi and Jaideep Ahlawat, it is set to release on October 16, 2026.

title: Tanishaa Mukerji slams 'well-educated elitist Hindus' for ‘blind hate’
description: Tanishaa Mukerji recently took to X to voice her concerns regarding the narrow-mindedness of elitist Hindus, urging them to prioritize their patriotism over sensational media narratives. She advocates for logical discourse in political matters and has been actively promoting respectful conduct at the upcoming Durga Puja event. Her engagement with fans continues through both social media and various public events, highlighting her commitment to constructive dialogue.

title: Nana Patekar’s cause of death revealed: Autopsy report finds blood clot
description: On October 8, Indian cinema lost a true gem, Nana Patekar, who succumbed to a heart attack at his residence. The postmortem indicated that a blood clot in the left main coronary artery was to blame. Despite the valiant efforts of medical responders, he was declared dead at 5:10 am. His funeral, attended by numerous prominent figures, highlighted his profound influence on both Hindi and Marathi film industries.

title: Shobhinaw Satyaa praises Captain Smit: 'Made us realise the power of 'Hanuman Chalisa'
description: In a show of admiration, actor Shobhinaw Satyaa lauded Captain Smit Machchhar for his heroic response to the flydubai crisis. Machchhar recounted how he recited the Hanuman Chalisa during the ordeal, amplifying Satyaa's belief in faith. The confrontation that took place on September 30 resulted in injuries following an alleged attack from the co-pilot.

title: Makers end confusion over 'Ramayana' release date, drop new poster
description: Get ready for the cinematic extravaganza of ‘Ramayana: Part One’, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, now officially launching on November 5, 2026. Clearing up previous doubts, the film will open advance bookings on Dussehra. With Ranbir Kapoor portraying Ram and Sai Pallavi as Sita, it’s part one of an anticipated two-part saga aimed for completion by 2027, distributed worldwide by Sony Pictures, while Dharma Productions handles India’s distribution.

title: Ramayana: Gulshan urges viewers to rally behind film
description: Gulshan Devaiah, praised for playing King Kulashekara in “Kantara Chapter 1,” says convincing audiences in mythological roles isn’t difficult, though nostalgia and expectations can complicate some characters. He backs Ranbir Kapoor’s “Ramayana” going global, urging support for such films. “Little Thomas” is his next release.

title: Cyrus calls Dilip overrated; comic slams viral cook’s scripted act

title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan is a hero for us, but he’s allowed to be human': Abhishek Bachchan
description: Amitabh Bachchan is celebrating his 84th birthday on October 11 with numerous wishes from admirers. On the occasion, here's recalling the time when Abhishek Bachchan shared insights about their family dynamics and his father's dual role as a star and family man. He also spoke about how his parents feel about his career and how seeing his father at home despite being a superstar, taught him to stay detach from fame early on in life.

title: 'Jailer 2' advance BO: Rajinikanth’s mass entertainer surpasses Rs 20 crore

A notable chunk of these ticket sales is from international audiences, with India contributing around Rs 5.32 crore. Chennai is leading the pack among Indian cities, showcasing palpable excitement for Rajinikanth's iconic return as Muthuvel Pandian.

title: Big B steps out of Jalsa to thank fans for their wishes on 84th birthday
description: On October 11, the legendary Amitabh Bachchan celebrated his 84th birthday, drawing a massive crowd of fans to his Mumbai home. The festivities kicked off at midnight, with delighted fans chanting his name and distributing sweets. As stars from the film industry shared heartfelt birthday wishes, this annual ritual underscored the immense love and admiration his fans have for him, showcasing his continued relevance in cinema.

title: Khushbu Sundar slams AI misuse against women
description: Khushbu, known for her work as an actress and her political stance, recently voiced her alarm over the potential misuse of AI technology in generating inappropriate content. While acknowledging the advantages of AI, she stressed the grave risks associated with its misuse. Criticizing those who alter women's images, she advocated for self-reflection among these individuals, reminding everyone that digital manipulation can impact any woman, not solely public figures.

title: In 2021, Alec Baldwin shot cinematography by Halyna Hutchins on the set of 'Rust'
description: Alec Baldwin faced a devastating setback on the 'Rust' film set when he accidentally shot cinematographer Halyna Hutchins during a scene rehearsal. The aftermath unfolded with a flurry of investigations and lawsuits that pointed to potential negligence among the crew. In 2023, Baldwin was charged with involuntary manslaughter, but the charges were dropped later that year.

title: 'Haiku' actor Aegan responds to nepotism criticism and social media hate
description: In promoting his upcoming film 'Haiku', actor Aegan opened up about the ongoing chatter surrounding nepotism in the film industry. He acknowledged the benefits he enjoys due to his family ties, while also empathizing with the struggles of aspiring actors lacking industry connections. Aegan aims to champion emerging talent through his production efforts, addressing critics by clarifying his own unique journey.

title: Amitabh 84th birthday: Imtiaz hails ‘once-in-a-lifetime’ icon
description: Filmmaker Imtiaz Ali says there will never be another Amitabh Bachchan, who turned 84, and hopes to work with him someday after directing him in an ad film. Marking 25 years in cinema, Ali calls filmmaking a privilege, not pressure, and wants to give audiences a gift back.

title: In the 1980s, Robert De Niro convinced Nobu Matsuhisa to open a restaurant in NYC; it's now a multi-million-dollar empire
description: In the 1980s, Robert De Niro stumbled upon the culinary brilliance of Nobu Matsuhisa. Captivated by the flavors, he spent years convincing Matsuhisa to branch out to New York. This collaboration bore fruit in 1994, leading to the iconic Nobu restaurant opening in Tribeca. By 2013, Nobu ventured into hospitality with a Vegas hotel, and today it boasts a global presence, enchanting food lovers in Europe, Asia, and beyond.
